summary_rationale: SoftTech holds a genuine localized niche in Indian municipal plan scrutiny (AutoDCR/CivitPERMIT) with ₹132.90 Cr FY26 revenue (+39.5% YoY), a ₹302.35 Cr H1 FY27 order book, and 43.5% recurring standalone revenue mix. However, business quality fails compounder standards on capital efficiency and cash forensics: ROE is 2.77%, ROCE is 6.31%, Free Cash Flow has been negative for eight consecutive years (FY19–FY26) due to ₹30.50 Cr/year of capitalized software development, intangibles plus IAUD total ₹90.22 Cr (52.5% of owners' equity), unbilled contract assets stand at ₹53.52 Cr alongside a 4.3x jump in doubtful-debt provisions to ₹12.08 Cr in FY26, and promoter ownership fell 21.6 percentage points over three years to 18.89%.
